tagline: 柯达数码相机，2007 年发布
description: 柯达于2007年推出的数码相机。配备KODAK AF 5× Optical Aspherical Lens f2.8 to f5.1, focus range like a 36-180mm zoom lens for 35mm film。TTL-autofocus。

specs.传感器: 8.1 megapixels CCD, light sensitivity up to ISO 3200 at max. resolution 3275×2459 pixels, upto ISO 8000 at lower resolutions
specs.镜头: KODAK AF 5× Optical Aspherical Lens f2.8 to f5.1, focus range like a 36-180mm zoom lens for 35mm film
specs.曝光测光: multi-zone, center-weighted, or spot TTL-AE metering
specs.英文简介: The Kodak EasyShare Z885 might be called an avantgarde consumer compact digital.
